name: Activate a channel and show it on Home
description: Verifies the core PC workflow can choose a channel and make it the active production channel.
steps: Open Channels from the bottom navigation
Search for Bali Wedding DJ and activate it
expected: Home shows Bali Wedding DJ as the active channel.

name: Save and retain AI settings
description: Verifies Settings remains responsive on desktop and saved provider settings survive a reload.
steps: Open Settings and enter https://api.openai.com/v1 as AI API Base URL, a non-empty test API key value, and gpt-5-mini as the text model
Refresh the page and reopen Settings
expected: The Settings page remains responsive and the saved base URL, API key field, and text model values are retained.

name: Block production when the brief is empty
description: Verifies a production package is not started when the required brief is empty.
expected: The app shows the required-brief warning and does not create a content package.

name: Filter the channel registry on mobile
description: Verifies the responsive UI can find a specific channel from the registry.
steps: Type TechVerse into the channel search field
expected: TechVerse is visible in the filtered results and unrelated channels are not shown.
